answer: Each identity claims one orchard block with an 80-credit bond. At a random dawn hour, the holder files a sonnet of fourteen readings from its block, with velvet trap catch, soil moisture. Auditors check it against that hour's feed; a stale, copied, or mismatched sonnet burns the bond. One stand-in cannot cover many blocks at once, so each fake needs its own hire: 45 for the first, 45+18(k-1) for the k-th, 9,036,000 for 1,000 fakes plus 80,000 bonded. A rented-attendance ring reusing one sonnet fails the feed check. An honest tender on site pays no fee and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
